title: ProtocolIdentityAliases
description: Protocol-local identifiers that may be preserved as aliases or evidence references but must not replace canonical SourceOS identity bindings.

a2a_agent_card_ref.description: Reference to an A2A agent card, descriptor, or equivalent discovery record.

a2a_task_ref.description: Reference to an A2A task, artifact, or task-scoped interaction.

mcp_server_ref.description: Reference to an MCP server identity or descriptor.

mcp_tool_ref.description: Reference to an MCP tool, tool call, or resource invocation.

mcp_resource_ref.description: Reference to an MCP resource exposed or consumed during the interaction.

anp_agent_ref.description: Reference to an ANP-style agent, DID, linked-data identifier, or agent network profile.

anp_service_ref.description: Reference to an ANP-style service, endpoint, meta-protocol descriptor, or linked-data service claim.

agui_session_ref.description: Reference to an AG-UI session, UI interaction session, or human-agent interaction context.

agui_component_ref.description: Reference to an AG-UI component, surface, event source, or UI control path.

agui_event_ref.description: Reference to a UI event or intent event that contributed evidence but did not authorize execution by itself.

aliases.description: Additional protocol-local aliases that do not yet have first-class fields. Each alias must state its protocol and reference value.
